callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to a project directory
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized with the project's source index when the project can be indexed, or None when indexing is unavailable

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_function_spans
callees.pre_condition: The CodeGraphExtractor instance is initialized and non-None; language is a valid language key string; filepath is a string path to a source file within the project
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (name: str, start_idx: int, end_idx: int) tuples for every function definition in the specified file, with 0-indexed inclusive spans, or None when the file is not indexed for the given language
